title: Wadi Surgicals, Hubertus Medical Products launch Enliva Active nitrile glove for HoReCa sector
summary: The black, food-safe nitrile glove is being introduced as India’s first dedicated black nitrile glove for the HoReCa segment

contentHtml:
The black, food-safe nitrile glove is being introduced as India’s first dedicated black nitrile glove for the HoReCa segment

Wadi Surgicals, owner of the Enliva nitrile glove brand, has partnered with Hubertus Medical Products, Andhra Pradesh, to launch Enliva Active, a black, food-safe nitrile glove developed for the HoReCa (Hotels, Restaurants and Catering) sector.

India’s foodservice industry is one of the country’s fastest-growing consumer sectors. The Indian foodservice market was estimated at approximately US$85.2 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach US$153.4 billion by 2031, growing at a CAGR of 10.3 per cent. The growth of restaurants, hotels, QSRs, cafés, catering and organised foodservice is creating increasing demand for products that support hygiene, safety and professional food handling.

Enliva Active is being introduced as India’s first dedicated black nitrile glove for the HoReCa segment, providing a Made-in-India alternative for restaurants, hotels, catering companies, food preparation and food handling environments.

The black colour provides a practical advantage in food handling, offering clear visual contrast against food and helping identify glove fragments in the event of accidental tearing.

The collaboration between Wadi Surgicals and Hubertus Medical Products reflects the power of Indian manufacturing partnerships to create products specifically for evolving domestic market requirements. Rather than simply replicating existing products, the partnership has focused on developing a dedicated glove for one of India’s fastest-growing service sectors.

Production of Enliva Active has commenced at approximately 60 lakh gloves per month, equivalent to 7.2 crore gloves annually, with plans to scale production to approximately 1 crore gloves per month in line with growing demand. Wadi Surgicals also plans to develop export markets for the product.

Speaking on the collaboration, Konda Anindith Reddy, Founder & MD, Wadi Surgicals., said:

“Enliva Active represents an important step for us because we are not simply entering another glove category, we are creating a Made-in-India product specifically for the HoReCa industry. The foodservice sector is growing rapidly, and hygiene and food safety are becoming increasingly important across restaurants, hotels and catering. Our partnership with Hubertus Medical Products brings together Indian capabilities to address this opportunity and build a product for India and, eventually, global markets. This is exactly the kind of collaboration that can strengthen Atmanirbhar Bharat.”

Speaking on the collaboration, Dr. Balaraju Jakkula, Managing Director, Hubertus Medical Products, said;

“We are excited to partner with Wadi Surgicals to bring Enliva Active to the Indian market. The HoReCa sector has distinct requirements when it comes to hygiene, food handling and professional presentation, and we saw an opportunity to develop a product specifically for this segment. Enliva Active combines the strengths of Indian manufacturing with a clear understanding of the needs of the food-service industry. We are proud to be part of this Made-in-India initiative and look forward to taking the product to markets beyond India as well.”

The partnership reinforces Wadi Surgicals’ commitment to expanding the Indian manufacturing collaborations, developing products for emerging sectors and building a stronger Made-in-India glove industry capable of serving both domestic and international markets.
